lo: I can find the unit rate and use it to compare prices.
formula: unit rate = total ÷ number of units
tip: Always write the units: AED per kg, km per hour.

questions.hint: A unit rate is for exactly 1 unit.
steps: A unit rate compares to 1 unit
AED 6 per 1 kg is for 1 kg

questions.text: Dates cost AED 18 for 3 kg. What is the price per kg?
questions.hint: Divide the total by the number of kg: 18 ÷ 3.

questions.text: A car travels 240 km in 3 hours. What is its speed in km per hour?
Shop A sells 2 L of laban for AED 7. Shop B sells 3 L for AED 9.60. Which is cheaper per litre?
questions.hint: Find the price for 1 L at each shop.
